title: Seeking the Physician of Knowledge
english: Let us follow the soul to the physician of knowledge; if we hunger, let us receive bread; if we have died, let us receive the resurrection. If we have fallen into ignorance, let us ask wisdom from the Wisdom.
But the word has drawn us out into the length of a word. And perhaps we have become an obstacle to the patristic teaching.

Yet the time calls to listen to greater words, so that, having been benefited by greater works, we may send up to God the doxology through the works, to whom is the glory now and always and unto the ages of ages (Ps 103:26). Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
